apple-blue.$description: Apple Blue — Primary CTA fill — the single saturated button on the page (Comprar, Learn more). Vivid mid-blue that reads as a switch-on moment against matte neutrals

link-blue.$description: Link Blue — Inline text links, footnote references, and underlined link borders. Slightly deeper and cooler than the CTA blue so links and buttons read as distinct actions

signal-green.$description: Signal Green — Accent stroke for positive health/sleep metric visualizations and decorative data highlights on product UI

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Orange outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges

iris-violet.$description: Iris Violet — Tertiary accent for multicolor data rings, decorative product UI, and illustration strokes

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Quaternary accent completing the Apple Watch activity ring palette

space-black.$description: Space Black — Primary text, heading fills, icon strokes, and card borders. Apple's near-black — softer than #000, reads warm against white

sterling.$description: Sterling — Secondary/muted text, nav borders, list dividers, and subdued UI labels

graphite.$description: Graphite — Nav border-bottom, link muted state, and mid-contrast UI text

slate.$description: Slate — Nav-specific dark text and borders in the top utility bar

smoke.$description: Smoke — Disabled or de-emphasized button/link background fill

pebble.$description: Pebble — Hairline borders, inactive dividers, and subdued list separators

concrete.$description: Concrete — Light surface tone for secondary buttons and list-item fills sitting on white

fog.$description: Fog — Page canvas and section background — the dominant pale-gray that separates content bands from pure white card surfaces

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, button text on dark fills, nav backgrounds, and badge interiors

absolute.$description: Absolute — True black for hero image overlays, icon fills, and high-contrast heading strokes

sf-pro-display.$description: Headlines and display. The 48–64px range carries section titles like 'Lo principal.' and 'Más de cerca.' with aggressively tight letter-spacing (-0.015em to -0.003em) that lets words lock into a single visual block. Weight 600 is the workhorse; 700 appears on the most emphatic display sizes. 260px is the extreme hero-numeral scale. Substitute: Inter, system-ui.

sf-pro-text.$description: Body, nav, buttons, legal copy, and supporting UI. 17px is the canonical body size; 14px carries secondary descriptions and footnote text; 12px is reserved for micro-labels and legal fine print. Weight 400 for body, 600 for nav items, button labels, and emphasis. Tight tracking throughout (-0.022em at 12px down to -0.003em at 44px) keeps even long paragraphs visually dense. Substitute: Inter, -apple-system.
